# Checkout fails after applying a discount

## Description

The order cannot be placed after applying the WELCOME10 discount.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Opened the checkout page with one item in the cart
2. Applied the WELCOME10 discount code
3. Clicked Place order and saw the error

## Expected behavior

The order is placed and a confirmation appears.

## Current behavior

An error appears and checkout stays on the payment page.

## Environment

- Page: http://shop.example.test/checkout
- Started: 2026-10-19T06:32:44.861Z
- Operating system: Linux
- Browser: Chrome 154.0.8037.97
- Platform: Linux x86_64
- User agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/154.0.8037.97 Safari/537.36
- BugReceipt: 0.3.0
